context: Answers the frozen operator card ~/Buildo-scratch/p2close/CARD-floor-scorer.answered.md (FS-Q1 not chosen, FS-Q2 agreed, FS-Q3 corner lot; cause census ~/Buildo-scratch/p2close/floor-causes.md).

decisions.subject: Rows where the notice gives no numeric requirement (19 rows, NO ANSWER today)
decisions.recommendation: Not chosen: check the no-number test before the clause-not-keyed tests so these rows become NOT MODELLED and leave the answered denominator. The rows stay NO ANSWER and keep counting; these by-law rules must be built, not reclassified (examples: the garden-suite rule that compares the suite with the main building; setbacks that depend on the neighbours' buildings, front-yard averaging and abutting setbacks, where the input may come from density data or from the user). Rule text: A by-law requirement the notice states without a number stays NO ANSWER until the evaluator answers it; the scorer never reclassifies it to leave the denominator. Follow-up: plan the relative-rule evaluation and the neighbour-setback input (density data or user input).

decisions.subject: 10.5.50.10(4) and (5): apartment-only provisions
decisions.recommendation: Agreed: the clauses are out of scope (apartments) and no unit exists, so the scorer calls them clause not keyed (NO ANSWER) today; mark them NOT MODELLED with the reason apartment-only provision, out of scope. Rule text: A clause that applies only to a building type outside McBylaws scope (apartments) is NOT MODELLED with that reason, never NO ANSWER.
